name: Cinema Mode Plus
description: Enable Cinema Mode with local trailers, trailer libraries (including Trailers4Jellyfin downloads) and pre-rolls. Cinema Mode Plus is a fork of Cinema Mode by CherryFloors (https://github.com/CherryFloors/jellyfin-plugin-cinemamode), released under the MIT License.
overview: Cinema Mode with trailer libraries, local trailers and pre-rolls. Based on Cinema Mode by CherryFloors.

versions.changelog:
- Fix no intros at all (including pre-rolls) when a regular movie library was selected as a trailer library.
- Never use videos longer than 10 minutes as library trailers, and ignore movie extras in trailer libraries.
- Warn on the settings page and in the log when a trailer folder is named "Trailers" (Jellyfin does not index it).
- Log a summary of the intros chosen for each movie to make troubleshooting easier.

- First release of Cinema Mode Plus, a fork of Cinema Mode 0.6.0 by CherryFloors.
- Import settings from the original Cinema Mode plugin on first start.
- Add Trailer Source option to play trailers from trailer libraries, movie folders, or both.
- Add mixing modes (alternate, shuffle, library first, movie folder first) for combined trailer sources.
- Add Trailers4Jellyfin integration to use its download folder as a trailer library.
- Add option to allow unrated library trailers when enforcing rating limits.
